vector_memory.semantic_summary: This module centralizes and defines canonical enumerated types for the AI system, acting as a core data model vocabulary. It defines EngineType, ModelType, and InferenceBackend, providing strict identifiers for engine types (e.g., HUGGINGFACE), model architectures (e.g., CAUSAL_LM), and computational backends (e.g., GPU_CUDA). It ensures consistent system-wide categorization and routing logic across various services.
